content.title: About
content.content: A blend of vegetables and meat designed for children aged 6 months to 3 years. It contains carefully selected carrots, broccoli, cauliflower, chicken breast and beef, steamed and pureed to a smooth consistency. The product contains no added sugar, salt or artificial preservatives.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The vegetables provide vitamins A, C and K as well as fiber that supports healthy digestion.
Meat supplies high‑quality protein essential for growth and muscle development.
All ingredients are heat‑treated at temperatures of at least 95 °C, ensuring microbiological safety.
The formula was developed together with pediatricians and nutritionists to meet the needs of a growing child.
Packaging is made from safe food‑grade plastic that can be reused.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Protein and amino acids from meat aid the development of muscles, organs and the immune system.

items.title: Eye health
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots is converted to vitamin A, which is vital for vision.

items.title: Bone strength
items.content: Vitamin K and calcium in broccoli contribute to bone mineralization.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C from cauliflower boosts the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Healthy digestion
items.content: Fiber from the vegetables improves gut motility and helps prevent constipation.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some children may develop an allergic reaction to beef or chicken; monitor closely when first introduced.

items.title: Foodborne illness
items.content: Improper storage can allow bacterial growth; keep the product refrigerated.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: For infants under 12 months, offer only a fully pureed consistency.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Although no salt is added, natural sodium in meat may need to be limited for children with kidney issues.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve as a smooth puree, gently warmed to body temperature. If needed, thin with breast milk or formula to achieve the desired consistency.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C and consume within 48 hours after opening. Do not thaw a whole frozen package; only defrost the portion you plan to use, and do so in the fridge.
